note: Scripture came from the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, irvhin) — the text `language_seed.py` records for this language — fetched whole from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx, which serves USX). All 66 books, 31,104 verses on disk for the run, so translators could look up anything that sounded like scripture rather than work from a citation-only crib (these sermons cite no chapter:verse at all).

A `mined` row means an exact byte substring (>=45 chars, or the whole verse when shorter) of the IRV verse measured against the FINISHED hi body, not a translator's claim. A verse the translator re-personed, re-aimed, or recombined to fit the author's argument is recorded self_rendered even where it shows a long verbatim span, because changing the wording makes it ours.

USX parse guarded against the three documented traps: <note> stripped content-and-all; section-heading paras (style s/d/ms/mr/sr/r/qa/cl/cd) stripped even where they sit inside a verse span; verse text taken from sid to the matching eid. Output re-scanned: zero residual tags, zero contaminated tails.
